ei.title: 8번: The Rise of Voter Advice Applications
ei.subject: 빠른독해바른독해_구문독해_2024

fullPassage: Voter advice applications, sometimes referred to as VAAs, are short online quizzes. Voters who take them have their opinions on social issues matched to the policies of political parties. VAAs get users engaged in the political process by encouraging them to do further research on these policies and participate in elections more. They also help users decide on who they should vote for. What's more, most VAAs collect and save data anonymously, allowing it to be used to create informative reports about the country's political situation. Currently, VAAs are popular in a number of European countries, including the Netherlands, Germany, and Finland. They are expected to become more widely used around the world in the near future.

questions.passage: Voter advice applications, sometimes referred to as VAAs, are short online quizzes. Voters who take them have their opinions on social issues (A)[opposed / matched] to the policies of political parties. VAAs get users (B)[engaged / bored] in the political process by encouraging them to do further research on these policies and participate in elections more. They also help users decide on who they should vote for. What's more, most VAAs collect and save data anonymously, allowing it to be used to create informative reports about the country's political situation. Currently, VAAs are (C)[rare / popular] in a number of European countries, including the Netherlands, Germany, and Finland. They are expected to become more widely used around the world in the near future.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) matched=맞춰진 / opposed=반대되는 (B) engaged=참여하는 / bored=지루한 (C) popular=인기 있는 / rare=드문
det.analysis:
① matched—engaged—popular: 의견이 정책에 맞춰지고, 사용자를 참여시키며, 유럽에서 인기 있다 ←정답
② opposed: (A) 정책에 '반대되게' 맞춰진다는 것은 문맥과 반대
③ bored: (B) 사용자를 '지루하게' 만든다는 것은 참여 유도 문맥과 반대
④ rare: (C) 여러 유럽 국가에서 '드물다'는 것은 인기 있다는 문맥과 반대
det.tip: 의견을 정책에 matched, 사용자를 engaged, 유럽에서 popular한 흐름

questions.passage: Voter advice applications, sometimes referred to as VAAs, are short online quizzes. Voters who take them have their opinions on social issues matched to the policies of political parties. VAAs get users engaged in the political process by encouraging them to do (A)[less / further] research on these policies and participate in elections more. They also help users decide on who they should vote for. What's more, most VAAs collect and save data (B)[anonymously / openly], allowing it to be used to create informative reports about the country's political situation. Currently, VAAs are popular in a number of European countries, including the Netherlands, Germany, and Finland. They are expected to become more (C)[narrowly / widely] used around the world in the near future.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) further=추가적인 / less=더 적은 (B) anonymously=익명으로 / openly=공개적으로 (C) widely=널리 / narrowly=좁게
det.analysis:
① less: (A) '더 적은' 조사를 하도록 한다는 것은 참여 유도 문맥과 반대
② openly: (B) 데이터를 '공개적으로' 저장한다는 것은 뒤의 익명 보호 취지와 반대
③ further—anonymously—widely: 추가 조사 유도 + 익명 저장 + 널리 사용 ←정답
④ narrowly: (C) '좁게' 사용된다는 것은 세계로 확산되는 문맥과 반대
det.tip: further research(추가 조사), anonymously(익명), widely used(널리 사용)의 흐름

They also help users decide on who they should vote for. What's more, most VAAs collect and save data anonymously, allowing it to be used to create informative reports about the country's political situation. Currently, VAAs are (C)[rare / popular] in a number of European countries, including the Netherlands, Germany, and Finland. questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) matched=맞춰진 / opposed=반대되는 (B) encouraging=권장하는 / discouraging=단념시키는 (C) popular=인기 있는 / rare=드문
det.analysis:
① opposed: (A) 정책에 '반대되게' 맞춘다는 것은 문맥과 반대
② matched—encouraging—popular: 의견을 정책에 맞추고, 조사를 권장하며, 유럽에서 인기 있다 ←정답
③ discouraging/rare: (B) 조사를 '단념시키고' (C) '드물다'는 문맥과 반대
④ opposed/discouraging/rare: 세 곳 모두 문맥과 반대
det.tip: matched(맞춰진), encouraging(권장하는), popular(인기 있는)의 긍정적 흐름

questions.passage: Voter advice applications, sometimes referred to as VAAs, are short online quizzes. Voters who take them have their ①<u>opinions</u> on social issues matched to the policies of political parties. VAAs get users ②<u>engaged</u> in the political process by encouraging them to do further research on these policies and participate in elections more. They also help users decide on who they should vote for. What's more, most VAAs collect and save data anonymously, allowing it to be used to create informative reports about the country's political situation. Currently, VAAs are ③<u>rare</u> in a number of European countries, including the Netherlands, Germany, and Finland. They are expected to become more ④<u>widely</u> used around the world in the near future.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ① opinions=의견 ② engaged=참여하는 ③ popular→rare (부적절) ④ widely=널리
det.analysis:
① opinions: 사회 문제에 대한 의견 — 적절
② engaged: 사용자를 정치 과정에 참여시킴 — 적절
③ rare: 여러 유럽 국가에서 '드물다'? 인기 있다는 popular가 원문 ←정답
④ widely: 세계에서 더 널리 사용될 것 — 적절
det.tip: 네덜란드·독일·핀란드 등에서 인기 있다는 흐름 → popular, rare는 반대

Voters who take them have their opinions on social issues ①<u>matched</u> to the policies of political parties. VAAs get users engaged in the political process by encouraging them to do ②<u>further</u> research on these policies and participate in elections more. They also help users decide on who they should vote for. What's more, most VAAs ③<u>collect</u> and save data anonymously, allowing it to be used to create informative reports about the country's political situation. Currently, VAAs are popular in a number of European countries, including the Netherlands, Germany, and Finland. questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ① matched=맞춰진 ② further=추가적인 ③ collect=수집하다 ④ widely→narrowly (부적절)
det.analysis:
① matched: 의견이 정책에 맞춰짐 — 적절
② further: 추가 조사를 하도록 함 — 적절
③ collect: 데이터를 수집하고 저장함 — 적절
④ narrowly: 세계에서 더 '좁게' 사용될 것? 널리 확산되는 widely가 원문 ←정답
det.tip: become more widely used(더 널리 사용) 흐름 → narrowly는 정반대

det.korean: ① encouraging=권장하는 ② collect=수집하다 ③ informative→misleading (부적절) ④ expected=예상되는
det.analysis:
① encouraging: 추가 조사를 권장함 — 적절
② collect: 데이터를 수집함 — 적절
③ misleading: 나라의 정치 상황에 대한 '오해를 주는' 보고서? 유익한 informative가 원문 ←정답
④ expected: 세계에서 더 널리 쓰일 것으로 예상됨 — 적절
det.tip: informative reports(유익한 보고서)가 원문 → misleading은 반대 의미

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 encouraging와 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: encouraging=권장하는 / urging=촉구하는 / forbidding=금지하는 / ignoring=무시하는 / delaying=지연시키는

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 popular와 의미가 가장 반대인 것은?

questions.passage:

questions.stem: 다음 (A)와 (B)에서 밑줄 친 save의 의미로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: save: (A) 구하다 (B) 저장하다
det.analysis:
① (A) 구하다 (B) 저장하다: 물에 빠진 아이를 구하다 + 데이터를 저장하다 ←정답
② (A) 절약하다 (B) 구하다: 아이를 '절약하다'? 부적절
③ (A) 구하다 (B) 절약하다: 데이터를 '절약하다'? 문맥 부적절
④ (A) 저장하다 (B) 구하다: 아이를 '저장하다'? 부적절
det.tip: save의 다의어: 구하다(사람) vs 저장하다(데이터)

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "a formal event in which people vote to choose a person for an official or political position"

det.korean: selection=선택 / election=선거 / auction=경매 / donation=기부

② election: 선거 — 사람들이 투표로 공직자를 뽑는 공식 행사 ←정답
③ auction: 경매 — 물건을 파는 절차
④ donation: 기부 — 돈·물품을 주는 행위
det.tip: people vote to choose a person for an official position = election(선거)

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: refer(부르다) → referred(과거분사). be referred to as = ~라고 불리다 (수동 표현)
det.analysis: refer를 과거분사 referred로 변환. 'sometimes referred to as VAAs' = '때때로 VAAs라고 불리는' — 분사구로 앞 명사를 수식하는 수동 표현이므로 과거분사가 필요
det.tip: be/being referred to as ~ → 수동 → 과거분사 referred

questions.passage: VAAs get users engaged in the political process by __________ (encourage) them to do further research on these policies.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: encourage(권장하다) → encouraging(동명사). 전치사 by 뒤에는 동명사(-ing)가 옴
det.analysis: encourage를 동명사 encouraging으로 변환. 'by encouraging them' = '그들을 권장함으로써' — 전치사 by의 목적어 자리이므로 동명사 형태가 필요
det.tip: 전치사 by + 동명사(-ing) → encouraging

questions.passage: Voter advice applications, sometimes referred to as VAAs, are short online quizzes. Voters who take them have their opinions on social issues matched to the policies of political parties. VAAs get users engaged in the __________ by encouraging them to do further research on these policies and participate in elections more. They also help users decide on who they should vote for. What's more, most VAAs collect and save data anonymously, allowing it to be used to create informative reports about the country's political situation. Currently, VAAs are popular in a number of European countries, including the Netherlands, Germany, and Finland. They are expected to become more widely used around the world in the near future.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: online quizzes=온라인 퀴즈 / near future=가까운 미래 / political process=정치 과정 / social media=소셜 미디어
det.analysis:
① online quizzes: 온라인 퀴즈 — VAA의 형식이지 참여시키는 대상이 아님
② near future: 가까운 미래 — 뒷문장의 표현이며 이 자리와 문맥 안 맞음
③ political process: 조사를 권장하고 선거 참여를 유도하며 사용자를 정치 과정에 참여시킴 ←정답
④ social media: 소셜 미디어 — 본문에 없는 개념
det.tip: encourage research + participate in elections → 정치 과정(political process) 참여

What's more, most VAAs collect and save data anonymously, allowing it to be used to create informative reports about the country's political situation. questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: give up=포기하다 / carry out=수행하다 / look after=돌보다 / vote for=~에게 투표하다
det.analysis:
① give up: 누구를 '포기할지' 결정하도록 돕는다? 선거 문맥과 안 맞음
② carry out: 누구를 '수행할지'? 문맥 부적절
③ look after: 누구를 '돌볼지'? 문맥 부적절
④ vote for: 누구에게 투표할지 결정하도록 도움 ←정답
det.tip: help users decide on who they should ______ → vote for(~에게 투표하다)
